name: claudetto-you-should-know
description: Shows a note above the prompt when a side check finds something you likely missed. Off by default; once on, one small request before each action that can change something, and no telemetry.

sideCheckEnabled.title: Side check
sideCheckEnabled.description: Use `true` to turn the side check on. Left at `false`, every hook of this plugin passes straight through and nothing is requested, so an installed copy costs nothing until it is turned on.
